description: Is this payments or digital-asset firm registered or licensed, where, and is it active: FinCEN MSB registrations (US), NY DFS virtual-currency licensees and trust charters, the UK FCA Financial Services Register (live), plus the firm's LEI record. Returns licensed / possible_match / not_found with every registration found (authority, number, status, activities, link) and the registries covered, so absence is reported as absence from those registries, not as proof. Use for fintech and VASP onboarding, partner due diligence and crypto-to-bank flows.

jurisdiction.description: Country or region to narrow to (US, US-NY, GB)
